title: record page: a related list's date column still mixes relative and absolute faces (RelatedList builds its cells without inGridColumn, which #25884 added for grids)
body:
Filing class: ① user-visible defect, the remainder of #25884 outside its claim. Found by the #25884 developer (os-dev-report 6428277761, PR #26341 Acceptance notes). The reach is read from the code and not measured in a browser.

## What
PR #26341 (#25884) gives `CellRendererProps` an `inGridColumn` flag. With it set, a `date` field with no declared `format` paints one absolute face down the column, and the relative phrase moves to the tooltip. `ObjectGrid` passes the flag on every column cell it builds. The record page's related lists draw their own table cells in `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx` (the cell builder around `:1654` on `main`) without the flag. So a related list's date column still shows "Yesterday" next to "Sep 20, 2025": the defect #25884 fixed for grids, and the same reasoning applies (absolute in a sortable column, relative at most as a tooltip).

## Expected
RelatedList's table cells pass `inGridColumn`, so an undeclared date column reads in one absolute face, with the relative phrase as its title. A declared `format` still wins. Pin it the way `ObjectGrid.dateColumnOneFace-25884` pins the grid.

## Sequencing
Blocked by #26341 (the flag must exist on `main`). `RelatedList.tsx` is on the plugin-detail landing line (#26055 → #26277 → #26325). Claim it after #26341 merges, and re-record `plugin-detail.json`.

Dedupe: "related list date column relative", "RelatedList inGridColumn", "mixed date faces related". None found.
